about: Club discovery and gaming questions (Entry 34; generic rule since Entry 36). Every club or community question must: show a BeachSync search button with a sensible term (beachsyncTerm), name no invented club, and name only organizations that appear in one of the pages it cites (clubsFromSources, checked against knowledge/*.md). Tests don't require any specific club. BeachSync itself is never fetched. Gaming uses the ASI Games Area page. Run with: TESTS_FILE=tests/club-and-gaming-questions.json RESULTS_FILE=docs/test-results-clubs.md npm run test:questions

tests.question: I'm Cambodian, how can I get involved with my culture on campus?
tests.expected_behavior: Generic club rule: a BeachSync search for a Cambodian keyword; any group it names (for example the Cambodian Student Society) comes from a cited page; no 'contact details were removed' note.

tests.question: I'm a CS student, what clubs can help me gain experience?
tests.expected_behavior: Generic club rule: a BeachSync search about computer science; any club it names comes from a cited page.

tests.question: is there a chess club
tests.expected_behavior: No source lists a chess club: says our pages don't list one (or falls back), never invents one. A BeachSync search for chess.

tests.question: clubs for nursing students
tests.expected_behavior: Generic club rule: a BeachSync search for nursing; any club it names comes from a cited page.

tests.question: is there an underwater basket weaving club
tests.expected_behavior: No such club in our sources: says so (or falls back), never invents one. A BeachSync search (from Gemini's keyword, or the student's own words if Gemini leaves it empty).

tests.question: where can i play video games on campus
tests.expected_behavior: Answer from the ASI Games Area page: the Games Center is closed for the FUTURE U Project and the Esports Lounge moved to Peterson Hall 1 (PH1) Room-218. Or, if it falls back, Who can help = ASI. Never a Tuition and Fees button. Not a club question, so no BeachSync button.
tests.expected_fact: Esports Lounge will be relocated to Peterson Hall 1 (PH1) Room-218
